reasons: Existing validation rule addition: request bodies with a/b/value = Infinity currently pass the typeof==="number" check (JSON.parse('1e400') yields Infinity, a legal JSON number literal), then JSON.stringify silently turns an Infinity result into null in the 200 response instead of a 400 error

Fix is confined to the HTTP request-validation layer in src/server.ts; no new endpoint, no new response field, no change to openapi/openapi.yaml or contracts/*.ocl (the existing 400 'Invalid request/precondition violation' response shape already documents this error path)

Small existing-logic change (one additional finiteness check, applied uniformly at the three request handlers that parse numeric input) — worth a light implement+verify isolation pass rather than zero orchestration, since it changes accepted-vs-rejected request behavior across three endpoints
